pokemon.name: Bulbasaur
pokemon.description: Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.

fields.Name: Bulbasaur
fields.Pokedex: Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.

pokemon.name: Ivysaur
pokemon.description: To support its bulb, Ivysaur's legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.

fields.Name: Ivysaur
fields.Pokedex: To support its bulb, Ivysaur's legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.

pokemon.name: Venusaur
pokemon.description: Venusaur's flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.

fields.Name: Venusaur
fields.Pokedex: Venusaur's flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.

pokemon.name: Charmander
pokemon.description: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

fields.Name: Charmander
fields.Pokedex: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

pokemon.name: Charmeleon
pokemon.description: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.

fields.Name: Charmeleon
fields.Pokedex: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.

pokemon.name: Charizard
pokemon.description: A Charizard flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.

fields.Name: Charizard
fields.Pokedex: A Charizard flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.

pokemon.name: Squirtle
pokemon.description: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds.

fields.Name: Squirtle
fields.Pokedex: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds.

pokemon.name: Wartortle
pokemon.description: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon's toughness in battle.

fields.Name: Wartortle
fields.Pokedex: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon's toughness in battle.

pokemon.name: Blastoise
pokemon.description: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.

fields.Name: Blastoise
fields.Pokedex: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.

pokemon.name: Caterpie
pokemon.description: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.

fields.Name: Caterpie
fields.Pokedex: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.

pokemon.name: Metapod
pokemon.description: Its shell is as hard as an iron slab. A Metapod does not move very much because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the shell.

fields.Name: Metapod
fields.Pokedex: Its shell is as hard as an iron slab. A Metapod does not move very much because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the shell.

pokemon.name: Butterfree
pokemon.description: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.

fields.Name: Butterfree
fields.Pokedex: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.

pokemon.name: Weedle
pokemon.description: A Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

fields.Name: Weedle
fields.Pokedex: A Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

pokemon.name: Kakuna
pokemon.description: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.

fields.Name: Kakuna
fields.Pokedex: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.

pokemon.name: Beedrill
pokemon.description: A Beedrill is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.

fields.Name: Beedrill
fields.Pokedex: A Beedrill is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.

pokemon.name: Pidgey
pokemon.description: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.

fields.Name: Pidgey
fields.Pokedex: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.

pokemon.name: Pidgeotto
pokemon.description: This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

fields.Name: Pidgeotto
fields.Pokedex: This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

pokemon.name: Pidgeot
pokemon.description: Pidgeot has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many trainers are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.

fields.Name: Pidgeot
fields.Pokedex: Pidgeot has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many trainers are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.

pokemon.name: Rattata
pokemon.description: A Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.

fields.Name: Rattata
fields.Pokedex: A Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.

pokemon.name: Raticate
pokemon.description: A Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

fields.Name: Raticate
fields.Pokedex: A Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

pokemon.name: Spearow
pokemon.description: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.

fields.Name: Spearow
fields.Pokedex: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.

pokemon.name: Fearow
pokemon.description: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.

fields.Name: Fearow
fields.Pokedex: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.

pokemon.name: Ekans
pokemon.description: An Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.

fields.Name: Ekans
fields.Pokedex: An Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.

pokemon.name: Arbok
pokemon.description: This Pokémon has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.

fields.Name: Arbok
fields.Pokedex: This Pokémon has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.

pokemon.name: Pikachu
pokemon.description: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

fields.Name: Pikachu
fields.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

pokemon.name: Raichu
pokemon.description: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

fields.Name: Raichu
fields.Pokedex: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

pokemon.name: Sandshrew
pokemon.description: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.

fields.Name: Sandshrew
fields.Pokedex: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.

pokemon.name: Sandslash
pokemon.description: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.

fields.Name: Sandslash
fields.Pokedex: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.

pokemon.name: Nidoran♀
pokemon.description: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

fields.Name: Nidoran♀
fields.Pokedex: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

pokemon.name: Nidorina
pokemon.description: When it is with its friends or family, its barbs are tucked away to prevent injury. It appears to become nervous if separated from the others.

fields.Name: Nidorina
fields.Pokedex: When it is with its friends or family, its barbs are tucked away to prevent injury. It appears to become nervous if separated from the others.

pokemon.name: Nidoqueen
pokemon.description: It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body. This Pokémon is at its strongest when it is defending its young.

fields.Name: Nidoqueen
fields.Pokedex: It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body. This Pokémon is at its strongest when it is defending its young.

pokemon.name: Nidoran♂
pokemon.description: The male Nidoran has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokémon's notice.

fields.Name: Nidoran♂
fields.Pokedex: The male Nidoran has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokémon's notice.

pokemon.name: Nidorino
pokemon.description: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.

fields.Name: Nidorino
fields.Pokedex: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.

pokemon.name: Nidoking
pokemon.description: A Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

fields.Name: Nidoking
fields.Pokedex: A Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

pokemon.name: Clefairy
pokemon.description: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired Clefairy go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.

fields.Name: Clefairy
fields.Pokedex: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired Clefairy go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.

pokemon.name: Clefable
pokemon.description: A Clefable uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

fields.Name: Clefable
fields.Pokedex: A Clefable uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

pokemon.name: Vulpix
pokemon.description: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.

fields.Name: Vulpix
fields.Pokedex: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.

pokemon.name: Ninetales
pokemon.description: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived Ninetales will have fur that shines like gold.

fields.Name: Ninetales
fields.Pokedex: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived Ninetales will have fur that shines like gold.

pokemon.name: Jigglypuff
pokemon.description: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a Jigglypuff's song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.

fields.Name: Jigglypuff
fields.Pokedex: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a Jigglypuff's song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.

pokemon.name: Wigglytuff
pokemon.description: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a Wigglytuff is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.

fields.Name: Wigglytuff
fields.Pokedex: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a Wigglytuff is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.

pokemon.name: Zubat
pokemon.description: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.

fields.Name: Zubat
fields.Pokedex: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.

pokemon.name: Golbat
pokemon.description: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and Pokémon. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.

fields.Name: Golbat
fields.Pokedex: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and Pokémon. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.

pokemon.name: Oddish
pokemon.description: It grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.

fields.Name: Oddish
fields.Pokedex: It grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.

pokemon.name: Gloom
pokemon.description: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

fields.Name: Gloom
fields.Pokedex: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

pokemon.name: Vileplume
pokemon.description: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a Vileplume turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.

fields.Name: Vileplume
fields.Pokedex: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a Vileplume turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.

pokemon.name: Paras
pokemon.description: A Paras has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.

fields.Name: Paras
fields.Pokedex: A Paras has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.

pokemon.name: Parasect
pokemon.description: Parasect are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.

fields.Name: Parasect
fields.Pokedex: Parasect are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.

pokemon.name: Venonat
pokemon.description: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.

fields.Name: Venonat
fields.Pokedex: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.

pokemon.name: Venomoth
pokemon.description: Venomoth are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.

fields.Name: Venomoth
fields.Pokedex: Venomoth are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.

pokemon.name: Diglett
pokemon.description: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.

fields.Name: Diglett
fields.Pokedex: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.

pokemon.name: Dugtrio
pokemon.description: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.

fields.Name: Dugtrio
fields.Pokedex: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.

pokemon.name: Meowth
pokemon.description: Meowth withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

fields.Name: Meowth
fields.Pokedex: Meowth withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

pokemon.name: Persian
pokemon.description: A Persian's six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.

fields.Name: Persian
fields.Pokedex: A Persian's six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.

pokemon.name: Psyduck
pokemon.description: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.

fields.Name: Psyduck
fields.Pokedex: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.

pokemon.name: Golduck
pokemon.description: A Golduck is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.

fields.Name: Golduck
fields.Pokedex: A Golduck is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.

pokemon.name: Mankey
pokemon.description: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

fields.Name: Mankey
fields.Pokedex: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

pokemon.name: Primeape
pokemon.description: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.

fields.Name: Primeape
fields.Pokedex: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.

pokemon.name: Growlithe
pokemon.description: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this Pokémon won't forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.

fields.Name: Growlithe
fields.Pokedex: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this Pokémon won't forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.

pokemon.name: Arcanine
pokemon.description: This fleet-footed Pokémon is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.

fields.Name: Arcanine
fields.Pokedex: This fleet-footed Pokémon is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.

pokemon.name: Poliwag
pokemon.description: It is possible to see this Pokémon's spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

fields.Name: Poliwag
fields.Pokedex: It is possible to see this Pokémon's spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

pokemon.name: Poliwhirl
pokemon.description: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.

fields.Name: Poliwhirl
fields.Pokedex: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.

pokemon.name: Poliwrath
pokemon.description: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This Pokémon can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.

fields.Name: Poliwrath
fields.Pokedex: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This Pokémon can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.

pokemon.name: Abra
pokemon.description: A Pokémon that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses Teleport to change its location once every hour.

fields.Name: Abra
fields.Pokedex: A Pokémon that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses Teleport to change its location once every hour.

pokemon.name: Kadabra
pokemon.description: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into Kadabra while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.

fields.Name: Kadabra
fields.Pokedex: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into Kadabra while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.

pokemon.name: Alakazam
pokemon.description: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an Alakazam's muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.

fields.Name: Alakazam
fields.Pokedex: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an Alakazam's muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.

pokemon.name: Machop
pokemon.description: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

fields.Name: Machop
fields.Pokedex: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

pokemon.name: Machoke
pokemon.description: A belt is worn by a Machoke to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.

fields.Name: Machoke
fields.Pokedex: A belt is worn by a Machoke to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.

pokemon.name: Machamp
pokemon.description: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.

fields.Name: Machamp
fields.Pokedex: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.

pokemon.name: Bellsprout
pokemon.description: A Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

fields.Name: Bellsprout
fields.Pokedex: A Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

pokemon.name: Weepinbell
pokemon.description: At night, a Weepinbell hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.

fields.Name: Weepinbell
fields.Pokedex: At night, a Weepinbell hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.

pokemon.name: Victreebel
pokemon.description: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.

fields.Name: Victreebel
fields.Pokedex: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.

pokemon.name: Tentacool
pokemon.description: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.

fields.Name: Tentacool
fields.Pokedex: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.

pokemon.name: Tentacruel
pokemon.description: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.

fields.Name: Tentacruel
fields.Pokedex: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.

pokemon.name: Geodude
pokemon.description: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.

fields.Name: Geodude
fields.Pokedex: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.

pokemon.name: Graveler
pokemon.description: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and huge boulders with thunderous tackles.

fields.Name: Graveler
fields.Pokedex: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and huge boulders with thunderous tackles.

pokemon.name: Golem
pokemon.description: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.

fields.Name: Golem
fields.Pokedex: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.

pokemon.name: Ponyta
pokemon.description: A Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.

fields.Name: Ponyta
fields.Pokedex: A Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.

pokemon.name: Rapidash
pokemon.description: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a Rapidash turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

fields.Name: Rapidash
fields.Pokedex: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a Rapidash turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

pokemon.name: Slowpoke
pokemon.description: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends whole days just loafing at the water's edge.

fields.Name: Slowpoke
fields.Pokedex: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends whole days just loafing at the water's edge.

pokemon.name: Slowbro
pokemon.description: Its tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

fields.Name: Slowbro
fields.Pokedex: Its tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

pokemon.name: Magnemite
pokemon.description: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.

fields.Name: Magnemite
fields.Pokedex: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.

pokemon.name: Magneton
pokemon.description: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

fields.Name: Magneton
fields.Pokedex: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

pokemon.name: Farfetch'd
pokemon.description: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This Pokémon occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.

fields.Name: Farfetch'd
fields.Pokedex: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This Pokémon occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.

pokemon.name: Doduo
pokemon.description: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.

fields.Name: Doduo
fields.Pokedex: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.

pokemon.name: Dodrio
pokemon.description: A peculiar Pokémon species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.

fields.Name: Dodrio
fields.Pokedex: A peculiar Pokémon species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.

pokemon.name: Seel
pokemon.description: Seel hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

fields.Name: Seel
fields.Pokedex: Seel hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

pokemon.name: Dewgong
pokemon.description: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

fields.Name: Dewgong
fields.Pokedex: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

pokemon.name: Grimer
pokemon.description: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, Grimer's favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.

fields.Name: Grimer
fields.Pokedex: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, Grimer's favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.

pokemon.name: Muk
pokemon.description: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making Muk reek like putrid kitchen garbage.

fields.Name: Muk
fields.Pokedex: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making Muk reek like putrid kitchen garbage.

pokemon.name: Shellder
pokemon.description: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

fields.Name: Shellder
fields.Pokedex: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

pokemon.name: Cloyster
pokemon.description: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The Cloyster shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.

fields.Name: Cloyster
fields.Pokedex: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The Cloyster shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.

pokemon.name: Gastly
pokemon.description: When exposed to a strong wind, a Gastly's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

fields.Name: Gastly
fields.Pokedex: When exposed to a strong wind, a Gastly's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

pokemon.name: Haunter
pokemon.description: If a Haunter beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don't approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.

fields.Name: Haunter
fields.Pokedex: If a Haunter beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don't approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.

pokemon.name: Gengar
pokemon.description: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

fields.Name: Gengar
fields.Pokedex: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

pokemon.name: Onix
pokemon.description: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an Onix from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

fields.Name: Onix
fields.Pokedex: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an Onix from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

pokemon.name: Drowzee
pokemon.description: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that a Drowzee is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

fields.Name: Drowzee
fields.Pokedex: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that a Drowzee is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

pokemon.name: Hypno
pokemon.description: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a Hypno's hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.

fields.Name: Hypno
fields.Pokedex: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a Hypno's hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.

pokemon.name: Krabby
pokemon.description: Krabby live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.

fields.Name: Krabby
fields.Pokedex: Krabby live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.

pokemon.name: Kingler
pokemon.description: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this Pokémon quickly tires.

fields.Name: Kingler
fields.Pokedex: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this Pokémon quickly tires.

pokemon.name: Voltorb
pokemon.description: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a Poké Ball. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran trainers treat it with caution.

fields.Name: Voltorb
fields.Pokedex: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a Poké Ball. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran trainers treat it with caution.

pokemon.name: Electrode
pokemon.description: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

fields.Name: Electrode
fields.Pokedex: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

pokemon.name: Exeggcute
pokemon.description: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

fields.Name: Exeggcute
fields.Pokedex: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

pokemon.name: Exeggutor
pokemon.description: Originally from the tropics, Exeggutor's heads grow larger with exposure to bright sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an Exeggcute.

fields.Name: Exeggutor
fields.Pokedex: Originally from the tropics, Exeggutor's heads grow larger with exposure to bright sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an Exeggcute.

pokemon.name: Cubone
pokemon.description: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

fields.Name: Cubone
fields.Pokedex: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

pokemon.name: Marowak
pokemon.description: A Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

fields.Name: Marowak
fields.Pokedex: A Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

pokemon.name: Hitmonlee
pokemon.description: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.

fields.Name: Hitmonlee
fields.Pokedex: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.

pokemon.name: Hitmonchan
pokemon.description: A Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.

fields.Name: Hitmonchan
fields.Pokedex: A Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.

pokemon.name: Lickitung
pokemon.description: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

fields.Name: Lickitung
fields.Pokedex: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

pokemon.name: Koffing
pokemon.description: Getting up close to a Koffing will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.

fields.Name: Koffing
fields.Pokedex: Getting up close to a Koffing will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.

pokemon.name: Weezing
pokemon.description: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be made. To Weezing, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.

fields.Name: Weezing
fields.Pokedex: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be made. To Weezing, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.

pokemon.name: Rhyhorn
pokemon.description: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.

fields.Name: Rhyhorn
fields.Pokedex: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.

pokemon.name: Rhydon
pokemon.description: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.

fields.Name: Rhydon
fields.Pokedex: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.

pokemon.name: Chansey
pokemon.description: Chansey lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those who have lost their appetite.

fields.Name: Chansey
fields.Pokedex: Chansey lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those who have lost their appetite.

pokemon.name: Tangela
pokemon.description: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

fields.Name: Tangela
fields.Pokedex: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

pokemon.name: Kangaskhan
pokemon.description: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

fields.Name: Kangaskhan
fields.Pokedex: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

pokemon.name: Horsea
pokemon.description: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.

fields.Name: Horsea
fields.Pokedex: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.

pokemon.name: Seadra
pokemon.description: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.

fields.Name: Seadra
fields.Pokedex: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.

pokemon.name: Goldeen
pokemon.description: In the springtime, schools of Goldeen can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.

fields.Name: Goldeen
fields.Pokedex: In the springtime, schools of Goldeen can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.

pokemon.name: Seaking
pokemon.description: It punches holes in boulders on stream- beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.

fields.Name: Seaking
fields.Pokedex: It punches holes in boulders on stream- beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.

pokemon.name: Staryu
pokemon.description: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.

fields.Name: Staryu
fields.Pokedex: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.

pokemon.name: Starmie
pokemon.description: People in ancient times imagined that Starmie were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.

fields.Name: Starmie
fields.Pokedex: People in ancient times imagined that Starmie were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.

pokemon.name: Mr. Mime
pokemon.description: A Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

fields.Name: Mr. Mime
fields.Pokedex: A Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

pokemon.name: Scyther
pokemon.description: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

fields.Name: Scyther
fields.Pokedex: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

pokemon.name: Jynx
pokemon.description: A Jynx sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.

fields.Name: Jynx
fields.Pokedex: A Jynx sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.

pokemon.name: Electabuzz
pokemon.description: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use Electabuzz as lightning rods.

fields.Name: Electabuzz
fields.Pokedex: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use Electabuzz as lightning rods.

pokemon.name: Magmar
pokemon.description: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees.

fields.Name: Magmar
fields.Pokedex: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees.

pokemon.name: Pinsir
pokemon.description: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.

fields.Name: Pinsir
fields.Pokedex: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.

pokemon.name: Tauros
pokemon.description: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

fields.Name: Tauros
fields.Pokedex: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

pokemon.name: Magikarp
pokemon.description: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many Magikarp deposited there by the flow.

fields.Name: Magikarp
fields.Pokedex: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many Magikarp deposited there by the flow.

pokemon.name: Gyarados
pokemon.description: It is an extremely vicious and violent Pokémon. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.

fields.Name: Gyarados
fields.Pokedex: It is an extremely vicious and violent Pokémon. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.

pokemon.name: Lapras
pokemon.description: People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.

fields.Name: Lapras
fields.Pokedex: People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.

pokemon.name: Ditto
pokemon.description: A Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.

fields.Name: Ditto
fields.Pokedex: A Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.

pokemon.name: Eevee
pokemon.description: An Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.

fields.Name: Eevee
fields.Pokedex: An Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.

pokemon.name: Vaporeon
pokemon.description: Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.

fields.Name: Vaporeon
fields.Pokedex: Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.

pokemon.name: Jolteon
pokemon.description: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur's static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.

fields.Name: Jolteon
fields.Pokedex: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur's static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.

pokemon.name: Flareon
pokemon.description: Flareon's fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

fields.Name: Flareon
fields.Pokedex: Flareon's fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

pokemon.name: Porygon
pokemon.description: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A Porygon is copy-protected so it cannot be duplicated.

fields.Name: Porygon
fields.Pokedex: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A Porygon is copy-protected so it cannot be duplicated.

pokemon.name: Omanyte
pokemon.description: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.

fields.Name: Omanyte
fields.Pokedex: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.

pokemon.name: Omastar
pokemon.description: An Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.

fields.Name: Omastar
fields.Pokedex: An Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.

pokemon.name: Kabuto
pokemon.description: This Pokémon has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. Kabuto have not changed for 300 million years.

fields.Name: Kabuto
fields.Pokedex: This Pokémon has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. Kabuto have not changed for 300 million years.

pokemon.name: Kabutops
pokemon.description: Kabutops once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.

fields.Name: Kabutops
fields.Pokedex: Kabutops once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.

pokemon.name: Aerodactyl
pokemon.description: Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.

fields.Name: Aerodactyl
fields.Pokedex: Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.

pokemon.name: Snorlax
pokemon.description: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.

fields.Name: Snorlax
fields.Pokedex: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.

pokemon.name: Articuno
pokemon.description: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.

fields.Name: Articuno
fields.Pokedex: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.

pokemon.name: Zapdos
pokemon.description: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

fields.Name: Zapdos
fields.Pokedex: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

pokemon.name: Moltres
pokemon.description: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.

fields.Name: Moltres
fields.Pokedex: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.

pokemon.name: Dratini
pokemon.description: A Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

fields.Name: Dratini
fields.Pokedex: A Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

pokemon.name: Dragonair
pokemon.description: A Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.

fields.Name: Dragonair
fields.Pokedex: A Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.

pokemon.name: Dragonite
pokemon.description: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

fields.Name: Dragonite
fields.Pokedex: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

pokemon.name: Mewtwo
pokemon.description: A Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.

fields.Name: Mewtwo
fields.Pokedex: A Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.

pokemon.name: Mew
pokemon.description: A Mew is said to possess the genes of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

fields.Name: Mew
fields.Pokedex: A Mew is said to possess the genes of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

pokemon.name: Chikorita
pokemon.description: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

fields.Name: Chikorita
fields.Pokedex: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

pokemon.name: Bayleef
pokemon.description: A Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

fields.Name: Bayleef
fields.Pokedex: A Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

pokemon.name: Meganium
pokemon.description: The fragrance of a Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

fields.Name: Meganium
fields.Pokedex: The fragrance of a Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

pokemon.name: Cyndaquil
pokemon.description: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokémon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

fields.Name: Cyndaquil
fields.Pokedex: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokémon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

pokemon.name: Quilava
pokemon.description: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.

fields.Name: Quilava
fields.Pokedex: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.

pokemon.name: Typhlosion
pokemon.description: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames. Typhlosion create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

fields.Name: Typhlosion
fields.Pokedex: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames. Typhlosion create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

pokemon.name: Totodile
pokemon.description: Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

fields.Name: Totodile
fields.Pokedex: Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

pokemon.name: Croconaw
pokemon.description: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.

fields.Name: Croconaw
fields.Pokedex: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.

pokemon.name: Feraligatr
pokemon.description: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.

fields.Name: Feraligatr
fields.Pokedex: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.

pokemon.name: Sentret
pokemon.description: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one gets separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

fields.Name: Sentret

pokemon.name: Furret
pokemon.description: A Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

fields.Name: Furret
fields.Pokedex: A Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

pokemon.name: Hoothoot

fields.Name: Hoothoot
fields.Pokedex: It has an internal organ that senses the earth's rotation. Using this special organ, a Hoothoot begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.

pokemon.name: Noctowl
pokemon.description: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. Noctowl owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.

fields.Name: Noctowl
fields.Pokedex: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. Noctowl owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.

pokemon.name: Ledyba
pokemon.description: Ledyba communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.

fields.Name: Ledyba
fields.Pokedex: Ledyba communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.

pokemon.name: Ledian
pokemon.description: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many Ledian. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.

fields.Name: Ledian
fields.Pokedex: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many Ledian. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.

pokemon.name: Spinarak

fields.Name: Spinarak
fields.Pokedex: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a Spinarak determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.

pokemon.name: Ariados
pokemon.description: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.

fields.Name: Ariados

pokemon.name: Crobat

fields.Name: Crobat
fields.Pokedex: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.

pokemon.name: Chinchou

fields.Name: Chinchou
fields.Pokedex: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight's reach.

pokemon.name: Lanturn
pokemon.description: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.

fields.Name: Lanturn
fields.Pokedex: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.

pokemon.name: Pichu
pokemon.description: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

fields.Name: Pichu
fields.Pokedex: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

pokemon.name: Cleffa
pokemon.description: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.

fields.Name: Cleffa
fields.Pokedex: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.

pokemon.name: Igglybuff

fields.Name: Igglybuff
fields.Pokedex: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.

pokemon.name: Togepi

fields.Name: Togepi
fields.Pokedex: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

pokemon.name: Togetic

fields.Name: Togetic
fields.Pokedex: It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a Togetic appears and shares its happiness with that person.

pokemon.name: Natu
pokemon.description: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A Natu's eyes look as if they are always observing something.

fields.Name: Natu
fields.Pokedex: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A Natu's eyes look as if they are always observing something.

pokemon.name: Xatu
pokemon.description: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that Xatu are emissaries from another world.

fields.Name: Xatu
fields.Pokedex: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that Xatu are emissaries from another world.

pokemon.name: Mareep

fields.Name: Mareep
fields.Pokedex: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

pokemon.name: Flaaffy

fields.Name: Flaaffy

pokemon.name: Ampharos

fields.Name: Ampharos
fields.Pokedex: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.

pokemon.name: Bellossom

fields.Name: Bellossom
fields.Pokedex: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a sun-summoning ritual.

pokemon.name: Marill

fields.Name: Marill
fields.Pokedex: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water's resistance.

pokemon.name: Azumarill

fields.Name: Azumarill
fields.Pokedex: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

pokemon.name: Sudowoodo
pokemon.description: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

fields.Name: Sudowoodo
fields.Pokedex: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

pokemon.name: Politoed
pokemon.description: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.

fields.Name: Politoed
fields.Pokedex: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.

pokemon.name: Hoppip

fields.Name: Hoppip
fields.Pokedex: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a Hoppip links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.

pokemon.name: Skiploom
pokemon.description: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

fields.Name: Skiploom
fields.Pokedex: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

pokemon.name: Jumpluff
pokemon.description: Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This Pokémon lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

fields.Name: Jumpluff
fields.Pokedex: Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This Pokémon lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

pokemon.name: Aipom
pokemon.description: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, Aipom's real hands have become rather clumsy.

fields.Name: Aipom
fields.Pokedex: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, Aipom's real hands have become rather clumsy.

pokemon.name: Sunkern

fields.Name: Sunkern
fields.Pokedex: Sunkern try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

fields.Name: Sunflora

pokemon.name: Yanma

fields.Name: Yanma

pokemon.name: Wooper

fields.Name: Wooper

pokemon.name: Quagsire

fields.Name: Quagsire

pokemon.name: Espeon

fields.Name: Espeon

pokemon.name: Umbreon

fields.Name: Umbreon

pokemon.name: Murkrow

fields.Name: Murkrow

pokemon.name: Slowking

fields.Name: Slowking

pokemon.name: Misdreavus

fields.Name: Misdreavus

pokemon.name: Unown

fields.Name: Unown
fields.Pokedex: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown.

pokemon.name: Wobbuffet

fields.Name: Wobbuffet

pokemon.name: Girafarig

fields.Name: Girafarig

pokemon.name: Pineco

fields.Name: Pineco

fields.Name: Forretress

pokemon.name: Dunsparce

fields.Name: Dunsparce

pokemon.name: Gligar

fields.Name: Gligar

pokemon.name: Steelix

fields.Name: Steelix

pokemon.name: Snubbull

fields.Name: Snubbull

fields.Name: Granbull

fields.Name: Qwilfish

pokemon.name: Scizor

fields.Name: Scizor

fields.Name: Shuckle

fields.Name: Heracross

fields.Name: Sneasel

fields.Name: Ursaring

fields.Name: Slugma

fields.Name: Magcargo

fields.Name: Remoraid

fields.Pokedex: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a Delibird sharing its food.

pokemon.name: Smoochum
pokemon.description: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake's surface to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.

fields.Name: Smoochum

pokemon.name: Elekid

fields.Name: Elekid

pokemon.name: Magby

pokemon.name: Miltank

pokemon.name: Blissey

fields.Name: Raikou

pokemon.name: Entei

fields.Name: Entei

pokemon.name: Suicune

fields.Name: Suicune

fields.Name: Larvitar

fields.Name: Lugia

pokemon.name: Ho-Oh

fields.Name: Treecko

pokemon.name: Grovyle

fields.Name: Grovyle

fields.Name: Swampert

pokemon.name: Poochyena

fields.Name: Linoone

fields.Name: Wurmple

fields.Name: Silcoon

fields.Name: Beautifly

fields.Name: Cascoon

fields.Name: Dustox

fields.Name: Lombre

fields.Name: Seedot

fields.Name: Surskit

fields.Name: Carvanha

pokemon.name: Sharpedo

fields.Name: Sharpedo
fields.Pokedex: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

pokemon.name: Wailmer

fields.Name: Wailmer

pokemon.name: Wailord

fields.Name: Wailord
fields.Pokedex: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

pokemon.name: Numel

fields.Name: Numel

pokemon.name: Camerupt

fields.Name: Camerupt
fields.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

pokemon.name: Torkoal

fields.Name: Torkoal

pokemon.name: Spoink

fields.Name: Spoink

fields.Name: Grumpig

fields.Name: Cacnea

fields.Name: Cacturne

fields.Name: Solrock

pokemon.name: Barboach

fields.Name: Barboach

pokemon.name: Whiscash

fields.Name: Whiscash

pokemon.name: Corphish

fields.Name: Corphish

fields.Name: Crawdaunt

fields.Name: Baltoy

fields.Name: Claydol

fields.Name: Lileep

fields.Name: Anorith

fields.Name: Armaldo

fields.Name: Feebas

fields.Name: Milotic

fields.Name: Kecleon

fields.Name: Shuppet

fields.Name: Chimecho

fields.Name: Absol

fields.Name: Wynaut

fields.Name: Spheal

fields.Name: Sylveon
fields.Pokedex: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. Then it attacks.

pokemon.name: Hawlucha

fields.Name: Hawlucha
fields.Pokedex: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

pokemon.name: Dedenne

fields.Name: Dedenne
fields.Pokedex: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

pokemon.name: Carbink

fields.Name: Carbink
fields.Pokedex: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

pokemon.name: Goomy

fields.Name: Goomy
fields.Pokedex: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

pokemon.name: Sliggoo

fields.Name: Sliggoo

pokemon.name: Goodra

fields.Name: Goodra

fields.Name: Klefki

fields.Name: Phantump
fields.Pokedex: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

fields.Name: Trevenant
fields.Pokedex: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

fields.Name: Pumpkaboo

fields.Name: Gourgeist

fields.Name: Bergmite

fields.Name: Avalugg

fields.Name: Noibat

pokemon.name: Noivern

fields.Name: Noivern

fields.Name: Xerneas
fields.Pokedex: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

fields.Name: Yveltal
fields.Pokedex: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

fields.Name: Zygarde
fields.Pokedex: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

pokemon.name: Diancie

fields.Name: Diancie
fields.Pokedex: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

fields.Name: Hoopa

fields.Name: Volcanion

fields.Name: Rowlet

fields.Name: Dartrix
fields.Pokedex: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

fields.Name: Decidueye

fields.Name: Litten
fields.Pokedex: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

fields.Name: Torracat

fields.Name: Incineroar

fields.Name: Popplio
fields.Pokedex: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

fields.Name: Brionne
fields.Pokedex: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn't know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

pokemon.name: Primarina

fields.Name: Primarina

fields.Name: Pikipek
fields.Pokedex: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

pokemon.name: Trumbeak

fields.Name: Trumbeak

fields.Name: Toucannon

fields.Name: Yungoos

fields.Name: Gumshoos

fields.Name: Grubbin

fields.Name: Charjabug

fields.Name: Vikavolt

fields.Name: Crabrawler

fields.Name: Crabominable

fields.Name: Cutiefly

fields.Name: Wishiwashi

fields.Name: Mareanie

fields.Name: Mudbray

fields.Name: Mudsdale

fields.Name: Salazzle

fields.Name: Stufful

fields.Name: Tsareena

fields.Name: Comfey

TERASHIFT.description: Enters Terastal Form when sent out.

TERASHELL.name: Tera Shell
TERASHELL.description: Resists all types when HP is full.

MEGASOL.name: Mega Sol
MEGASOL.description: Uses its moves as if in sunny weather.

DRAGONIZE.name: Dragonize
DRAGONIZE.description: Normal-type moves become Dragon-type and powered.

PIERCINGDRILL.name: Piercing Drill
PIERCINGDRILL.description: Contact moves deals a quarter of damage against protections.

SPICYSPRAY.name: Spicy Spray
SPICYSPRAY.description: Burns the attacker when hit by a damaging move.

NOABILITY.name: No Ability
NOABILITY.description: The user doesn't have any ability

VAMPIRICFANG.name: Vampiric Fang
VAMPIRICFANG.description: Bite moves heals the user. Stackable.

WARRIORDANCER.name: Warrior Dancer
WARRIORDANCER.description: Dance moves lowers the Attack of all Pokémon.

JOAT.name: Joat
JOAT.description: Removes STAB. Boosts all moves by 30%.

CRYOHEALING.name: Cryo Healing
CRYOHEALING.description: Restores HP if the Pokémon is frostbiten.

EXTREMEFOCUS.name: Extreme Focus
EXTREMEFOCUS.description: Boosts Special Attack if there is a status problem.

CHLOROPLAST.name: Chloroplast
CHLOROPLAST.description: Acts as if the sun is up.

BONECHILL.name: Bonechill
BONECHILL.description: May frostbite targets when a Pokémon makes contact.

OVERWHELMINGFROST.name: Overwhelming Frost
OVERWHELMINGFROST.description: Once per battle, the user Frostbites everything on switch in.

OVERWHELMINGVOLTAGE.name: Overwhelming Voltage
OVERWHELMINGVOLTAGE.description: Once per battle, the user Paralyzes everything on switch in.

OVERWHELMINGBLAZE.name: Overwhelming Blaze
OVERWHELMINGBLAZE.description: Once per battle, the user Burns everything on switch in.

SEADIVER.name: Sea Diver
SEADIVER.description: Raises Speed and give Water-Type moves a damage increase in rain.

TANGLINGROOTS.name: Tangling Roots
TANGLINGROOTS.description: Leech Seeds the target and ingrain.

FUELLEDBLAZE.name: Fuelled Blaze
FUELLEDBLAZE.description: Always crit if the target burnt.

POWERSURGE.name: Power Surge
POWERSURGE.description: Electric moves hit the targets allies.

CATASTROPHE.name: Cat-astrophe
